en.title: Purchasing Tournament Quota
en.excerpt: Step-by-step instructions for selecting packages, completing checkout via payment gateways, and instant quota activation.
en.content:
Purchasing Workflow

To top up your tournament quota:

  1. Log in to your Organizer Dashboard.
  2. Click Packages & Quota in the sidebar menu.
  3. Select your preferred tier (Standard or Elite) and the number of tournament slots required.
  4. Click Purchase Package to open the secure payment checkout.

Supported Payment Methods

Payments are processed in real-time through certified financial payment gateways (Mayar):

  • QRIS: Instant QR code scanning compatible with BCA, Mandiri Livin, GoPay, OVO, and Dana.
  • Virtual Accounts: Dedicated bank transfer accounts for BCA, Bank Mandiri, BNI, and BRI.
  • Credit & Debit Cards: Visa and Mastercard processing with 3D Secure verification.

Invoicing and Tax Receipts

Upon successful payment completion, an official commercial invoice is automatically generated and sent to your registered email address for accounting and bookkeeping records.

Troubleshooting Activation Delays

Quotas activate within seconds via automated server webhooks. If your quota counter does not update immediately after transfer, refresh your browser or contact technical support with your transaction reference number.
